descriptionHtml:
Elevate your bridal party with our Thigh-High Slit Chiffon Sleeveless Bridesmaid Dress! This stunning gown features a flowing chiffon fabric that drapes beautifully, complemented by a daring thigh-high slit for a touch of allure. Perfect for outdoor weddings or elegant receptions, this dress ensures your bridesmaids will turn heads all day long!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
